sleeping_bag.name: PANYAM 600
sleeping_bag.subtitle: ultralight 3-season down sleeping bag
sleeping_bag.description: Panyam 600 is presented as a lightweight 3-season sleeping bag suited to early spring and late autumn trips, and also to moderately cold winter nights. The series emphasizes trapezoid chambers, an independently adjusted neck collar, a slightly wider cut, anatomical shark-fin footbox and a 3D hood.
sleeping_bag.key_features:
- 970 g total weight
- 600 g of 850 FP ethically sourced Polish goose down
- Comfort -6 C / limit -13 C
- 3-season construction
- Trapezoid chambers
- Independent 3D collar around the neck
- Full-length 5 mm YKK zip with anti-snag system
- 3D hood
- Anatomical shark-fin footbox
- Slightly wider cut for supplementary insulation layers
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Cumulus positions Panyam 600 as a lightweight but serious 3-season bag that can stretch into colder conditions for experienced users using extra clothing or a liner.
sleeping_bag.ideal_for: Early spring trips, late autumn trips, moderately cold winter nights, mountainside or forest travel in the cold season.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: User-provided France capture shows 469 EUR. Indexed official Cumulus pages crawled earlier showed lower values such as 425 EUR.
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: Lifetime Experience warranty shown on official pages.
